_why: Classes gate crafting, mining, block use and crop harvesting. This is the mechanical reason 3 players must specialise.
class_slots: ClassSetup.slots() — read from server config; specialising DRAINS xp from off-classes (DRAIN_TOTAL_FROM_OFF_CLASSES=1.0, DRAIN_PER_SPECIALISATION=0.525), so you cannot max everything

harvest_success._critical: If a crop's curve has requiresHoe (the default), harvesting WITHOUT a hoe FAILS OUTRIGHT — you get nothing.
side_effects: untended crops use a separate lower chance (wheat/beetroot untended=0.4)
cocoa, melon and pumpkin set requiresHoe=false — harvestable bare-handed
harvest_success.auto_replant: FARMER rank 2 (REPLANT_RANK) replants automatically, costing 3 hoe durability (REPLANT_HOE_COST)

tool_gates._consequence: A lone FARMER is still capped at a wooden hoe; an iron hoe now needs BLACKSMITH 2 + MINER 2 iron.

crafting_hunger._formula: CraftingHunger.costOf(player, stack); charge() deducts, tooHungry() can REFUSE the craft
crafting_hunger._note: some entries are flat, some are {perRank:[...]} arrays indexed by class rank

movement_hunger._consequence: Sprinting costs 3.75x walking and swimming 15x (was 10x / 40x in civfabric 0.4.0). Idle now drains too (0.05). Walking is still the cheapest way to travel.

medic_healing._why: naturalRegeneration is off; MEDIC 'stitches' is the coop heal

specialisation.locking: Classes lock in once an XP/level tier is reached; ClassManager.specialisations(player) returns the locked set, isSpecialisation(player,type) tests membership.

drain.meaning: Once specialisations arm (at 85% of a tier), XP bleeds out of off-classes. Allocation is effectively one-way.

specialisation._key_arithmetic: 6 classes enabled by default x 2 slots = 12 class-slots needed for full coverage; 3 players x 2 slots = 6 slots covers all 6 enabled classes EXACTLY ONCE. The pack is dimensioned for a 3-player group.

mining_gates._rule: Ore blocks require a minimum MINER rank to mine at all.
mining_gates._critical_chain: iron_ore needs MINER 2 -> iron -> iron_hoe needs BLACKSMITH 2 -> hoe tier 3. Both sides dropped a rank in civfabric 0.4.2 (was MINER 3 / BLACKSMITH 3). Gold went UP to MINER 3.

_versions.note: refreshed 2026-09-21 after the pack updated; see CHANGELOG in BOT_DESIGN.md

class_xp_sources._note: Killing Pokemon now gives class XP; catching and battling give none. Blood moons (pacifism off) give 2.5x.
